title: Return window
content: Items can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund if unused and in original packaging. Sale items follow the same window. Return shipping is free for defective items and costs 6.95 dollars otherwise.

title: Refund timing
content: Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the warehouse receiving the return. Banks may take another 3 to 5 days to post the credit.

title: Exchanges
content: Exchanges for a different size or colour are free. Start one from the order page and ship the original item back. The replacement ships once the carrier scans the return label.

title: Non-returnable items
content: Gift cards, downloadable products, personalised items and opened hygiene products cannot be returned. Damaged or wrong items are always covered, whatever the category.

title: Standard shipping
content: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days and is free on orders over 50 dollars. Under that threshold it costs 4.95 dollars.

title: Express shipping
content: Express delivery takes 1 to 2 business days and costs 14.95 dollars. Orders placed before 2 pm local time ship the same day. Express is not available to PO boxes.

title: International shipping
content: We ship to 38 countries. Delivery takes 7 to 14 business days. Duties and taxes are collected at checkout so there are no surprise fees on arrival.

title: Tracking
content: A tracking link is emailed when the order leaves the warehouse. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show movement. If it stalls for 5 days, contact support and we open a carrier trace.

title: Lost packages
content: If a package shows delivered but you did not receive it, wait 48 hours and check with neighbours. Then contact support: we reship or refund after a 3 day carrier investigation.

title: Standard warranty
content: All products carry a 2 year warranty against manufacturing defects. Normal wear, accidents and misuse are not covered. Keep your order confirmation as proof of purchase.

title: Making a claim
content: Submit a claim with the order number and two photos of the defect. Claims are reviewed in 2 business days. Approved claims are repaired, replaced or refunded at our choice.

title: Extended protection
content: Extended protection adds 3 years and covers accidental damage on electronics over 100 dollars. It must be bought within 30 days of the original purchase and is non-refundable after 14 days.

title: Earning points
content: Members earn 1 point per dollar spent. Double points apply during the first week of each month. Points are credited when the return window closes.

title: Redeeming points
content: 100 points equal 5 dollars off. Points can cover up to half of an order and cannot be used on gift cards. Points expire after 18 months of account inactivity.

title: Membership tiers
content: Silver starts at 500 points a year, Gold at 1500 and Platinum at 4000. Gold adds free express shipping on one order a month. Platinum adds a dedicated support line.

title: Resetting a password
content: Use the Forgot password link on the sign in page. The reset email expires after 30 minutes. If it does not arrive, check spam, then request a new one after 5 minutes.

title: Changing an email address
content: Change your email under Account settings. We send a confirmation to the new address and the change takes effect once you click it. Order history stays attached to the account.

title: Deleting an account
content: Account deletion removes personal data within 30 days. Invoices are retained for 7 years because tax law requires it. Open orders must be delivered or cancelled first.

title: Accepted payments
content: We accept major credit cards, PayPal and instalment plans from Klarna. Gift cards can be combined with one other payment method per order.

title: Failed payments
content: A payment fails most often because of address mismatch or a bank fraud hold. Try again with the billing address exactly as the bank has it, or use another method.

title: Instalments
content: Instalment plans split orders over 100 dollars into 4 interest free payments, charged every 2 weeks. A late payment fee of 7 dollars applies after a 5 day grace period.

title: Data we collect
content: We collect order, delivery and device data to fulfil orders and prevent fraud. We do not sell personal data. Marketing email is opt in and can be turned off in one click.

title: Data requests
content: You can request a copy of your data or ask for correction at any time. Requests are answered within 30 days and verified against your account email.

title: Contacting support
content: Chat is open 8 am to 10 pm on weekdays and 9 am to 6 pm on weekends. Email replies arrive within 24 hours. Platinum members have a phone line with a 2 minute target wait.

title: Order cancellation
content: Orders can be cancelled until they enter picking, usually within 1 hour of purchase. After that, refuse delivery or use the return process instead.
